text:
Maya (docs): Hey team — I'm opening a small PR to refresh the Onboarding Labs 'Hello World' tutorial. It converts examples to SDK v6 and swaps the ephemeral auth flow to a CLI-based exchange. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — please review snippets and run the container smoke test if you can. Goal: land by EOW.

Ben (eng): LGTM, will check code snippets. Is the sample Dockerfile change required for builder vs runtime? Also what's the recommended env var name for tokens now?

Alexa (devex): Updated the quickstart generator to emit SDK v6 calls; the main rename is moving to the responses API. I'll patch examples to use `@redwood/client` v6 imports.

Maya (docs): Thanks. The change we want is to use `client.responses.generate({ model: '...' })` for the example. Env var convention: RW_API_KEY for long-lived keys (hosted) and RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN for the labs exchange.

Sam (qa): I can run the container test. What's the command? Added to my list.

Maya (docs): Steps in the PR description but pasting here:
```
# start local lab
docker build -t rw-hello .
docker run -e RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=... -p 3000:3000 rw-hello
# smoke: curl http://localhost:3000/ -> "Hello, Redwood!"
```
Use `tools/auth-exchange --expires 600` to get ephemeral tokens (CLI lives in dev-tools).

Ben (eng): Noted. Found one old snippet using `RW_TOKEN` — will replace. Also CI currently checks for node14; should we bump the sample to node18? The sample app deps expect newer runtime.

Jason (pm): We should avoid breaking instructor materials for workshops. Can we keep a backwards-compatible note? e.g., 'If you have RW_TOKEN, rename to RW_API_KEY'

Maya (docs): Good call. I'll add a compatibility note and a tiny migration table. Also adding a TODO to the PR to update the workshop slides.

Alexa (devex): I'll run the quick generator and push a test commit to the PR with dockerfile + env var updates.

deploy-bot: CI started for branch refresh/onboard-labs-842 — build 1172.

Sam (qa): Quick FYI — when I ran the container locally, the auth exchange CLI prints `ERROR: missing credentials` unless you run `export RW_CLI_CLIENT_ID=...`. Can we include that in README and the starter script?

Maya (docs): Great catch — will add explicit CLI env var instructions and an example `tools/auth-exchange --client-id abc123 --token-lifetime 600`.

Ben (eng): One more: the sample uses `cache: true` in the batch config but runtime doesn't support that flag anymore — swapping to `sessionCache: true`. I'll put that fix in my test commit.

Maya (docs): Awesome. If folks can do final CR by tomorrow noon, I'll merge and tag a docs release. @Alexa please watch for any CI flakiness.

Alexa (devex): On it. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI passed build 1172 — docs site preview available at https://deploy-preview-842.redwood.dev

Maya (docs): Preview looks good, merging now. Thanks all!
